Kenya Cane has been at the heart of Kenyan celebrations since 1976. We know what it takes to build
a legacy of excellence. We learn our lessons from the past and we pull together to inspire the future
and reach our goals. Kenya Cane believes that Kenyan excellence is only achieved one step at a time.
The path of excellence is not a race, but a journey we make together Side by side. Along the way,
we celebrate and cherish every victory no matter how small. We mark our successes with superior
quality and the smoothest of taste to strengthen our spirit to go forward.
The brand has partnered with Savara on a new thematic brand campaign ‘The Greats Toast Twice’
to inject inspiration, dynamism and respect.
